codex.primaryRisk: global and workspace AGENTS.md overlap can duplicate stable prefixes.
codex.recommendedDefault: Use a light global entry, keep skills lazy-loaded, and opt into full workspace skills only when the repo needs them.

copilot.primaryRisk: personal, repository, and organization instructions can stack inside usage-based billing requests.
copilot.recommendedDefault: Keep the Copilot entry thin, prefer one canonical scope, and use minimal-global for user-global skills unless full is explicitly requested.

cursor.primaryRisk: large Always rules can become a recurring Agent context tax.
cursor.recommendedDefault: Keep workspace rules small, prefer scoped rules, and avoid user-global rendered entry files.

claude-code.primaryRisk: CLAUDE.md, skills, and hooks can compound in long-running token-metered sessions.
claude-code.recommendedDefault: Keep CLAUDE.md light, rely on skills for detailed workflow rules, and keep hooks summary-only.
